summary: Full backend (21 pytest tests) + frontend E2E (desktop 1920 + mobile 390) of Lotofácil analyzer. All requested features work: upload of 300-contest sample (toast '300 novos concursos salvos.'), re-upload skips 300 ('0 novos..., 300 já existiam'), post-upload ask modal (yes/no), window options 10/20/30/50/0, qty >100 and 0 show games-count-error + disabled button, generation of N unique 15-number games on the chosen window (based_on correct), 5 tabs render tables, stats-window-{0,10,20,30,50} change totals (#291-#300 etc.), 4 exports download (games TXT strictly 'n,n,...' 15 per line), clear-history confirm -> empty-state. Statistics checked against hand-computed values on a small 3-contest dataset (first-line freq/together, parity, repeats, repeats parity label, top trio/quad counts, sum min/max/mean) - all correct. Perf: 3300 contests upload 1.4s, stats 0.57s, generate 100 games 0.6s.

minor.issue: repeats_parity label grammar: '10 repetidos - 1 pares x 9 ímpares' (singular should be '1 par'/'1 ímpar') - cosmetic
Lines with exactly 15 numbers are treated as no-contest-number; lines without contest number are deduped by number set (a genuinely repeated draw would be skipped) - acceptable edge case, just note

integration_issues.issue: errMsg returns e.response.data.detail which for 422 is an array of objects; toast.error(array) would render badly. UI prevents >100 but decimal qty (e.g. 5.5) passes client validation and gets 422 from backend
onClear has no try/catch - a failed DELETE causes unhandled promise rejection with no toast

action_items: (Minor) Validate qty is integer in GeneratorDialog (Number.isInteger) and make errMsg handle array detail (map .msg)
(Minor) Wrap onClear in try/catch with toast.error
(Minor) Singular/plural in repeats_parity label ('1 par', '1 ímpar')
critical_code_review_comments: backend/pytest.ini enforces '-n auto' (xdist); test_lotofacil_api.py is stateful (shared DB) and MUST be run with '-n 0' or tests race and fail
Upload inserts docs one-by-one (insert_one in loop) - could use insert_many for large files; currently fast enough (3300 in 1.4s)
Stats recomputes trios/quads from all contests on every request; OK at 3300 contests (0.57s)
seed_data_creation: DB left with the 300 contests from /app/tests/data/lotofacil_exemplo.txt (uploaded via UI in last mobile test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_lotofacil_api.py -n 0 -v (tests DELETE all contests). Frontend selectors all present as per review request; window.confirm needs a page dialog handler.
